firstPlayerRule: Each Round, the player who took the lowest-numbered Tactic card takes the first turn. Before that, players pick Tactics in order of lowest Fame; at the start everyone has 0 Fame, so ties go to the player whose Round Order token is lower in the column.
officialTieBreak: Ties in Fame when choosing Tactics go to the player whose Round Order token is in the lower position.
clarifications: Full game: players determine an order for choosing Heroes (the Rulebook gives no method), and Round Order tokens are stacked in that order with the first picker on top.
First (Walkthrough) game: the Round Order tokens are randomized during setup, and the player whose token is last picks a Tactic first.
After Tactics are chosen, the Round Order tokens are rearranged by Tactic number, lowest on top; that is the play order for the whole Round.
